decision: No concrete new source correctness defect found under pinned build and valid single-threaded typed Anchor Context assumptions. Retain explicit representation/unsafe limits; fresh root composed build/score/runtime gates remain required. No source modification or rollback proposed by this read-only review.

sites.assessment: The added helper repeats admitted rcinc/rcincp operations with only overflow edge probability changed to0.000005. Its actual T is RefCell<&mut[u8]>, which is Sized despite its inner fat slice reference. Therefore the outer default-Global Rc<T> remains a thin pointer, and this does not reinterpret the inner slice fat pointer or copy its mutable reference. Exactly one strong-count increment balances the returned copied Rc eventual drop; borrow flag, weak count and payload remain untouched.
sites.limits: Rc itself has private Rust layout, not a stable public layout guarantee. Existing3950 pinned actual-target layout/IR evidence applies structurally; this review does not establish layout portability or re-execute its probe.

sites.assessment: Probability0.00001 only annotates n==0, returning the same bool. The manual AccountInfo clone copies all five scalar/reference/boolean fields plus rent_epoch and clones each of lamports/data once; weighted lamports clone has the same reference-count behavior as above. AccountInfo is repr(C) and derives Clone; key/owner references and sign/writable/executable flags are preserved. No account borrows, balances, serialization or signer status is altered.
sites.limits: Raw count manipulation relies on valid live initialized nonzero single-threaded Rc and pinned allocation header. This inherits admitted code assumptions, not a new general safe Rc API.

sites.site: default-quote expect plus volatile curve creator-store reload (3992)
sites.assessment: llvm.expect annotates q==Pubkey::default without changing its boolean value, preserving short-circuit policy. The mutation site begins with a unique &mut Box<Account<BondingCurve>> inside the existing completed-before-rebind lexical block. For Sized/default allocator Box, its pointer storage identifies the same live Account. Reading the slot as a temporary &mut Account introduces no duplicated Box ownership; normal Anchor DerefMut stores the same Pubkey creator field. The loaded mutable reference is consumed by one assignment and not retained or used across later mutation/reborrow/CPI. Subsequent ordinary curve writes occur after the temporary ends.
sites.limits: This is unsafe raw-pointer/reference reinterpretation. Assessment assumes unique valid Box pointee, aligned initialized storage, immediate use, and no races or concurrent pointer mutation. No formal Rust aliasing proof or stable arbitrary private Account-layout assumption is claimed.

sites.assessment: MaybeUninit<[u64;9]> supplies72bytes at alignment8. A32-byte Pubkey is written through the prefix pointer before forming the shared &Pubkey, with capacity/alignment satisfied and all Pubkey bytes initialized. Only that Pubkey prefix is referenced; the40-byte tail is not exposed as a typed initialized array or read, and MaybeUninit has no destructor needing initialized elements. The buffer remains in scope and is not moved or written again while holder_key is used. Passing holder_key directly instead of an extra reference preserves the same value and seeds.
sites.limits: The tail is deliberate frame-layout padding rather than reconstructed historical dataflow. It must not be described as removal of all codegen placeholders or whole semantic/historical identity.

sites.site: owner-first pool gate plus immediate accounts reload (4000)
sites.assessment: Both tests inspect the same pool after previous operations, with no intervening CPI or account mutation. Owner comparison is pure and data_is_empty performs a temporary RefCell shared borrow whose guard is dropped in the method. Under the maintained valid context with no outstanding mutable pool-data borrow, both short-circuit truth tables are identical: only nonempty AMM-owned pool yields true. The pointer reload reads the initialized ctx.accounts inner reference slot as a temporary shared &AdminCto and preserves target and pargs values.
sites.limits: The ordering does change which memory is touched on failing short-circuit arms. If an outstanding mutable RefCell borrow or invalid pointer context were injected, old data-first evaluation could panic while owner-first evaluation skips it for non-AMM owners. No live mutable pool-data borrow is held at this site in the reviewed function; this is a valid-invocation assumption, not exhaustive equivalence over arbitrary invalid host contexts.

unchanged_gates: No on-chain instruction ABI, account list, discriminator, authorization check, fee bound or event serialization layout is changed by these source edits.
No error guard is intentionally removed. Intrinsic expect probabilities are within[0,1] and preserve their boolean operands.
Existing allow-neutral shims and placement placeholders remain explicit implementation assumptions; masked/oracle diagnostics cannot certify linked ELF identity.
independent_execution: No builds, source microprobes, VM runs, private compiler/oracle imports or external network collection in this peer review. Root performs fresh current-main build/score/runtime verification separately.
